title: 第一卷 人生初见 第十一章 族会开始第一卷 人生初见 第十二章 南宫傲的还击
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
伴随着入阁礼的圆满结束，族会开始。
族会会把此次入阁礼表现优秀的后辈们列为家族的培养对象，并由族内的各个长老挑选弟子，学成之后便会送往天行者进行历练。
无论家族中的旁系还是直系，进天行者历练，是长孙家的一条铁律。
从这点看，长孙家在丽山城如此强盛不是没有道理的。
但每年族会的重头戏是继承人的确定。
长孙问天在立族之初便提出，长孙家的继承人绝不会是孬种，在族会上任何人都可以向继承人发起挑战，若输了便废立另选。
当然这里挑战的人也绝对是同辈中人，长辈向晚辈出手这种事是万万做不出的。
同时还会邀请，全城有实力的家族、商行参会，为的便是征询他们的意见。
正是在上一年的族会，族中的长老提出要废除自己继承人的身份，之后长孙愤然离家出走。
想到这里长孙苦笑着摇摇头，一年的时间啊……还真是快，也不知今年的族会会有什么等着自己，想来反对自己继承的声音将会比去年更猛烈更强硬吧。
“少爷，少爷，到族会厅了。”初黎见长孙在族会厅门前出神，出声唤道。
长孙转头看着初黎一脸紧张，欲言又止的样子，明白初黎是在担心自己。
“傻丫头，想说什么就说吧。”
初黎犹豫半天开口说道：“无论怎么样少爷都是初黎的少爷，如果那帮恶人还想怎么样的话，我们就带着老爷离开丽山城，少爷不说了么，只要家人在，哪里都是家。”
听罢初黎的话，长孙心里一暖，前世自己没有家人，从未感到过家人的温暖，如今在这片陌生的残缺大陆，长孙想要守住这份温暖，担起这份责任。
看着初黎一脸认真而又坚决的表情，长孙微微一笑，伸手将初黎的刘海揉乱。
“初黎说的对，初黎也永远是我的初黎，等这次完了少爷就带着初黎和爷爷离开这里，好么。”
初黎被长孙的话和亲昵的举止，羞得面红耳赤，低声“嗯”了一声。
长孙笑着转过身去，眼神中的温柔也变成了坚定，身后便是要保护的人，自己无论如何也不能退缩。
长孙坚定的向族会厅走去，手扶上族会厅的实木大门，用力将门推开，走进族会厅。

此时族会厅人已经到的差不多，正对门的主座是长孙问天的位置，此时还未到场。
议事桌一边坐的是族中的长老和天行者中的骨干力量，而南宫傲便坐在首位。另一边坐的是城内各大家族商行。
见长孙走进来，在座的人都一副嘲笑的表情，想来是已经准备好待会在族会上看长孙如何出丑了，倒是南宫傲，仿佛没有发现长孙进来似的，稳坐不语。
长孙环视一周并未理睬那些戏虐嘲讽的目光，只是向红袖阁的司琴姑娘点头示意，便坐到了位置上。
长孙的位置与长孙问天正对，在长长的议事桌的这一头，倒像是被审判的邢台。
宽敞的族会厅此时坐满了人，长孙进来不久后，长孙问天也走进了族会厅，坐到了首位，族会正式开始。
长孙问天见人都已到场，开口道：“感谢各位赏脸来参加本族的族会。时间过得真快啊，这就又是一年过去了，咱们这些老骨头，终究还是跑不过时间，马上就要被淘汰咯。”
长孙问天看着在场的同辈中人说道，在场的年老者也都闻声笑了起来。场间的气氛略有缓和。
众人笑过后长孙问天继续道：“好了，既然跑不过时间那咱们就珍惜时间，我也不再啰嗦，咱们就进入今天的正题。近几年城内的防卫都由我天行者担负，压力实在不小，这些小辈也累坏了，今年我决定将这防卫的任务拿出来，由有能力者担负，大家看如何？”
长孙问天此言一出，顿时震惊了在场的人。
城内的防卫这可是个肥差，并非像长孙问天说的那样是个辛苦活。
毕竟谁担负了城内的护卫，就意味着城内大大小小家族商户都要向他上交税费，说白了就是保护费，这可不是一笔小数目。
最主要的是这城内护卫就相当于牢牢掌控了丽山城，这对于各大家族商行无疑是最大的诱惑。
长孙问天这出其不意的一手不仅惊住了城内其他的家族势力，更是把自家的长老和天行者的各骨干当场震惊。
越家不算是丽山城内的四大家族，但也算是势力不错的大家，此时越家的家主越驰反应倒是最快。
content_en:
With the successful conclusion of the entrance ceremony, the clan meeting begins.
The clan association will list the younger generations who have performed well in this ceremony as the family's training targets, and the elders in the clan will select disciples. After they have completed their studies, they will be sent to Skywalker for training.
Regardless of the collateral or direct lineage in the family, it is an iron rule of the eldest grandson family to gain experience as a Skywalker.
From this point of view, it is not unreasonable for the Changsun family to be so powerful in Lishan City.
But the highlight of every clan meeting is the determination of the heir.
Changsun Wentian proposed at the beginning of the establishment of the clan that the heir of the Changsun family would never be a coward. Anyone could challenge the heir at the clan meeting. If he lost, he would abolish the heir and choose another one.
Of course, the people who challenge here are definitely people of the same generation. It is absolutely impossible for an elder to attack a younger person.
At the same time, powerful families and business firms in the city will also be invited to attend the meeting in order to solicit their opinions.
It was at the clan meeting last year that the elders of the clan proposed to abolish his status as heir. After that, the eldest grandson ran away from home angrily.
Thinking of this, Changsun smiled bitterly and shook his head. One year... is really fast. I don't know what will be waiting for me in this year's clan meeting. I think the voices opposing my inheritance will be more fierce and tougher than last year.
"Master, Master, we have arrived at the clan meeting hall." Chu Li called out when he saw his eldest grandson lost in thought in front of the clan meeting hall.
Changsun turned his head and looked at Chu Li, who was nervous and hesitant to speak, and understood that Chu Li was worried about him.
"Silly girl, just say what you want to say."
Chu Li hesitated for a long time and said: "No matter what happens, the young master is Chu Li's young master. If those evil people still want to do something else, we will take the master and leave Lishan City. Master, didn't you say it? As long as your family is there, you are home wherever you are."
After hearing Chu Li's words, the eldest grandson felt warm in his heart. In his previous life, he had no family and had never felt the warmth of his family. Now in this strange and incomplete continent, the eldest grandson wants to keep this warmth and shoulder this responsibility.
Seeing Chu Li's serious and determined expression, Changsun smiled slightly and stretched out his hand to mess up Chu Li's bangs.
"Chu Li is right. Chu Li will always be my Chu Li. When this time is over, the young master will take Chu Li and grandpa away from here, okay?"
Chu Li blushed with embarrassment at Changsun's words and affectionate behavior, and whispered "Yeah" in a low voice.
Changsun smiled and turned around, and the gentleness in his eyes turned into determination. Behind him was the person he wanted to protect, and he could not retreat no matter what.
The eldest grandson walked resolutely to the clan hall, held on to the solid wooden door of the clan hall, pushed the door open hard, and walked into the clan hall.
At this time, most of the people in the clan hall have arrived. The main seat opposite the door is Changsun Wentian, who has not yet arrived.
Sitting on one side of the discussion table were the elders of the clan and the backbone of the Skywalkers, and Nangong Ao sat at the head of the table. Sitting on the other side were the major family businesses in the city.
Seeing the eldest grandson walking in, everyone present had mocking expressions. They were probably ready to see how the eldest grandson would make a fool of himself at the clan meeting later. However, Nangong Ao, as if he didn't notice the eldest grandson coming in, sat still and remained silent.
The eldest grandson looked around and ignored the teasing and sarcastic looks. He just nodded to Miss Siqin from Hongxiu Pavilion and sat down in his seat.
The position of the eldest grandson is directly opposite the eldest grandson Wentian. At this end of the long discussion table, it looks like Xingtai where he is being judged.
The spacious clan meeting hall was now full of people. Not long after the eldest grandson came in, the eldest grandson Wentian also walked into the clan hall and sat at the front seat. The clan meeting officially began.
When Changsun Wentian saw that everyone was present, he said, "Thank you all for coming to this clan meeting. Time flies so fast. Another year has passed. We old bones can't run away with time after all, and we will be eliminated soon."
Changsun Wentian looked at his peers and said, and the elders present also laughed. The atmosphere in the venue is slightly relaxedand.
After everyone laughed, Changsun Wentian continued: "Okay, since we can't run away with time, let's cherish the time. I won't be rambling anymore and let's get to the point of today. In recent years, I, Skywalker, have been responsible for the defense of the city. The pressure is really quite heavy, and these juniors are also exhausted. This year, I decided to take out this defense task and let those who are capable take it on. What do you think?"
As soon as Changsun Wentian said this, everyone present was shocked.
The defense of the city was a fat job, not a hard job as Changsun Wentian said.
After all, whoever takes on the role of guarding the city means that all the large and small family merchants in the city have to pay taxes and fees to him. To put it bluntly, it is protection fee, which is not a small amount of money.
The most important thing is that the guards in the city are equivalent to firmly controlling Lishan City, which is undoubtedly the biggest temptation for the major family businesses.
Changsun Wentian's unexpected move not only shocked other family forces in the city, but also shocked his own elders and the backbone of the Skywalkers on the spot.
The Yue family is not considered one of the four major families in Lishan City, but it is still considered a powerful family. At this time, the head of the Yue family, Yue Chi, reacted the fastest.
